swahili_text: Usikate tamaa. Kila mwanzo ni mzito!
english: Don't give up. Every beginning is hard!

swahili_text: Safi! Umeongeza mfululizo wako wa siku!
english: Nice! You added to your daily streak!
Always forward.
Try and you will see.
Every beginning is heavy.
Whoever strives, benefits.
Whatever you do, do it well.
Hope until the end.

swahili_text: Atakaye kufuga ng'ombe aanze na kuku.
english: Whoever wants to keep cattle should start with chickens.
Whoever wants what is under the bed must bend down.
Whoever wants what is far away walks to it.
You can't know what you can do until you've tried.

swahili_text: Kila ndege huruka kwa bawa lake.
english: Every bird flies with its own wing.
A hunter isn't afraid of thorns.
A tailor doesn't choose the cloth.
Aiming is not hitting.
The ocean isn't crossed by swimming.
If a hut is too much for you, build a shack.
Stretch your legs to the length of your bed.
Hardship at the start, joy at the end.

swahili_text: Usipokubali kutia mguu majini hutavuka kijito.
english: If you won't put your foot in the water, you won't cross the stream.
The bone that beat the hyena, can a dog manage it?
An arrow without feathers won't go far.

swahili_text: Kelele za chura hazimkatazi ng'ombe kunywa maji.
english: The frog's noise doesn't stop the cow from drinking.
The far traveller passes the mountain.

swahili_text: Ukioka samaki, huwezi kuondoa manyoya ya kuku.
english: While baking fish, you can't pluck a chicken.
Hurry, hurry has no blessing.
Anger brings loss.
Savings don't rot.
Intelligence is wealth.
The one who helps you in hardship is your friend.
Who doesn't heed elders breaks a leg.
One finger can't crush a louse.
One hand can't raise a child.
Be late, but arrive.
Spilled water can't be scooped up.
Who is like a mother?
Who walks slowly doesn't stumble.
Who runs stubs a toe.
A lion's cub is a lion.
Who doesn't ask has nothing to learn.
Who follows the bees won't miss the honey.
A good name shines in the dark.
Hearing is not seeing.
Who won't accept defeat is no true competitor.
Every door has its own key.
Getting lost is how you learn the way.
Eyes have no curtain.
Today it's you, tomorrow it's your neighbour.
Guest, come, so the host may prosper.
The patient one eats ripe fruit.
Who wants everything loses everything.
As you raise a child, so it grows.
A good thing sells itself; a bad thing hawks itself around.

swahili_text: Kutoa ni moyo, usambe ni utajiri.
english: Giving comes from the heart, not from wealth.
Regret is a grandchild.
Water you haven't entered, you don't know its depth.
A rope breaks at its weak spot.
Kind words draw a snake out of its hole.
Who earns in the sun eats in the shade.
A healer can't heal himself.
Who climbs a ladder comes down.
One with eyes isn't told 'look'.
The drum that booms loudest doesn't last.
The village rooster doesn't crow in town.
Going first is not arriving.

swahili_text: Heri kujikwaa kidole kuliko kujikwaa ulimi.
english: Better to stub your toe than your tongue.
What's past is no illness; let's tend to what's coming.

swahili_text: Nia njema ni tabibu, nia mbaya huharibu.
english: Good intentions heal; bad intentions destroy.
Harsh words don't break bones.
Wait below for the one who is up high.

swahili_text: Mpiga ngumi ukuta huumiza mkono wake.
english: Who punches a wall hurts his own hand.
Who digs a well falls in himself.
Every dog barks at its own door.

swahili_text: Asiyefunzwa na mamaye hufunzwa na ulimwengu.
english: Who isn't taught by their mother is taught by the world.
The knife has reached the bone.
A big pot is never without crust.
Two bulls can't share one pen.
With many captains, the ship goes off course.
A race on the rooftop ends at the edge.

swahili_text: Mbiu ya mgambo ikilia kuna jambo.
english: When the village horn sounds, something is up.
A trap without bait catches nothing.
A hungry person has no taboos.

swahili_text: Mzigo wa mwenzio ni kanda la usufi.
english: Your neighbour's load is a bag of kapok.
Who rides two horses at once splits apart.
Who boasts about drinking the water never drinks it.
An empty hand isn't licked.
Who fears the child crying will cry himself.
